highlights:

results.title: DR Congo FIFA World Cup 2026 preview: Player to watch out for, tactics, predicted playing XI - Sportstar
highlights:
DR Congo ended its pain-staking 52-year wait to feature in the World Cup when former Manchester United defender Axel Tuanzebe found himself at the right place at the right time to steer home a shot from the six-yard box to settle the Intercontinental Playoff against Jamaica.
[...]
A strong performance in the CAF qualifiers, where the side finished second behind Senegal, showed the team was more than deserving of a place in the finals. The side has grown steadily under Sebastien Desabre who had earmarked qualification to AFCON 2025 and the World Cup as his major
[...]
when he took over in 2022.
[...]
The Leopards have an experienced back four that can stifle any opponent on their day. Tuanzebe, Chancel Mbemba, Aaron Wan Bissaka and Arthur Masuaku have all played extensively in the Premier League and will look to scupper the attacking threat of Portugal and Colombia in Group K.
[...]
The African nation will need its forwards to fire to make a push for qualification from the group. Yoanne Wissa has two goal contributions to show in 18 appearances after a big money move to Newcastle United ahead of the recently concluded season. The lesser-heralded Fiston Mayele and Simon Banza will have to share the scoring load with Wissa and skipper Cedric Bakambu.
[...]
DR Congo’s lone World Cup appearance ended with three defeats and no goals scored in 1974. Eclipsing that dismal performance will be the first step the group will have to work towards.

# DR Congo forced into World Cup squad change after Bushiri ruled out through injury
[...]
The Democratic Republic of Congo have been forced to change their ⁠World Cup squad two days after announcing it, as Rocky Bushiri has been ruled out ‌due to injury and replaced by another Scottish-based player, Aaron ‌Tshibola.
[...]
Coach Sebastien Desabre named his 26-player squad on ‌Monday, but has withdrawn Hibernian centre back Bushiri. Kilmarnock‌defensive midfielder Tshibola has been called up.
[...]
"The Congolese ‌Football Federation Association confirms the withdrawal of Rocky Bushiri from the 2026 World Cup, following an injury sustained during ‌his last match with his club," ⁠the Congolese Association Football ‌Federation said in a statement.
[...]
"The technical staff has called ​up Aaron Tshibola, player for Kilmarnock FC, as a replacement."
[...]
## Revised DR Congo squad
[...]
Goalkeepers: Matthieu Epolo (Standard Liège), Timothy Fayulu (Noah), ‌Lionel Mpasi (Le Havre)
[...]
Defenders: Dylan Batubinsika (Larisa), Gedoon Kalulu (Aris Limassol), ​Steve Kapuadi (Widzew Lodz), Joris Kayembe (Racing Genk), Arthur Masuaku (Racing ‌Lens), Chancel Mbemba (Lille), Axel Tuanzebe (Burnley), Aaron Wan-Bissaka (West Ham United)
[...]
Midfielders: Theo Bongonda (Spartak Moscow), Brian Cipenga (Castellon), Meshack Elia (Alanyaspor), Gael Kakuta (Larisa), Edo Kayembe (Watford), Nathanael Mbuku (Montpellier), Samuel Moutoussamy (Atromitos), Ngal'ayel Mukau (Lille), Charles Pickel (Espanyol), Noah Sadiki (Sunderland), Aaron Tshibola (Kilmarnock)
[...]
Forwards: ⁠Cedric Bakambu (Real Betis), ⁠Simon Banza (Al Jazira), Fiston ‌Mayele (Pyramids), Yoane Wissa (Newcastle United).
